title: Responsive card and dashboard layouts
learningObjectives: Explain responsive card and dashboard layouts and use CSS Grid to create responsive two-dimensional layouts.

understand.concept: Responsive grid layouts adapt the number and size of tracks to available space. Patterns include repeat(auto-fit, minmax()), named areas that change at breakpoints, and minmax(0,1fr) to avoid intrinsic minimums forcing overflow.
understand.whyItMatters: A dashboard must remain usable on small screens and with translated labels or larger text. Do not preserve a desktop multi-column layout when it makes content too narrow.
understand.analogy: A responsive dashboard rearranges its rooms when the available floor area changes, while keeping the content and its relationships intact.
understand.analogyLimit: The analogy is simplified; CSS Grid follows formal track sizing, placement, and alignment algorithms.

explain.narrative: At narrow widths the dashboard changes to one column and preserves a logical sequence.

examples.code: <main class='dash'><header>Learning dashboard</header><nav>Courses</nav><section>Progress</section><aside>Upcoming tasks</aside></main><style>.dash{display:grid;gap:1rem;grid-template-columns:14rem minmax(0,1fr);grid-template-areas:'head head' 'nav progress' 'nav tasks'}.dash>*{padding:1rem;background:#e8f1f8}.dash header{grid-area:head}.dash nav{grid-area:nav}.dash section{grid-area:progress}.dash aside{grid-area:tasks}@media(max-width:42rem){.dash{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);grid-template-areas:'head' 'nav' 'progress' 'tasks'}}</style>
examples.explanation: At narrow widths the dashboard changes to one column and preserves a logical sequence.
examples.expectedOutput: A rendered CSS Grid example demonstrating the topic.

practise.guidedTask: Create a responsive dashboard with at least four regions. Test a narrow viewport and longer translated labels.
practise.independentTask: Build a responsive card or dashboard layout using this concept. Test long labels and narrow viewports.
hints: Inspect grid tracks with browser developer tools.
Check implicit tracks and minimum sizing.
Keep DOM and keyboard reading order logical.

</body></html>

questions.prompt: Which Grid value can help a flexible track shrink below its min-content size?
questions.explanation: minmax(0,1fr) allows the track's minimum sizing function to be zero.

questions.prompt: What should a responsive Grid layout preserve?
options: Readable content and logical DOM order
A fixed number of columns at every width
Visual placement regardless of keyboard order
questions.answer: Readable content and logical DOM order
questions.explanation: Responsive layout should adapt while preserving access and meaningful reading order.
